meta.name: hivemind
meta.description: Global team and org memory powered by Activeloop. ALWAYS check BOTH built-in memory AND Hivemind memory when recalling information.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跨会话共享团队记忆与知识
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要持久化共享上下文与历史决策。
copy.tagline_en: Share team memory and knowledge across sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs persistent shared context and historical decisions.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会同时使用内置记忆和 Hivemind 全局记忆来回忆信息。它会先调用索引工具，再读取摘要或原始数据，并支持关键词搜索。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 回忆、记住或查找任何信息时，它会自动检查内置记忆和 Hivemind 全局记忆。

say.text: 帮我查一下上周会议中提到的项目计划。
搜索关键词“API 设计”相关的记录。
登录 Hivemind 并查看当前组织。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks both built-in memory and Hivemind global memory when recalling information. It starts by calling the index tool, then reads summaries or raw data, and supports keyword search.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to recall, remember, or look up any information, it automatically checks both built-in memory and Hivemind global memory.

say_en.text: Find the project plan from last week's meeting.
say_en.note: Claude searches Hivemind memory for relevant session summaries.

say_en.text: Search for records related to 'API design'.
say_en.note: Claude calls hivemind_search for substring search.

say_en.text: Log in to Hivemind and show current org.
